name: Disable Samsung telemetry, ACR, voice and account services
description: Masks data-service/pushd/bms/appbinary-manager units, plants vendor opt-out switches (bms, voice-app, ondevice-voice), kills the ACR service app, Bixby/voice stack, SSO, csfs and CIS processes at every boot, and leaves a 30s watchdog (aul relaunches kills within ~20s; de-preloading does not stop it). Disable via the manager or the disabled flag; revival needs a reboot.
author: levkropp
